output.title: Renovated 1-Bedroom Apartment with Cellar and Elevator Access
output.description:
This renovated one-bedroom apartment offers 48 square meters of functional living space arranged on the basement level of a four-story building. The interior benefits from a recent update, showcasing tiled flooring throughout the compact open-plan living area which ensures ease of maintenance and a neutral palette.

The kitchen is equipped with a new fitted unit and an electric hob, providing a practical setup for culinary activities. The bathroom features modern tiled walls and a walk-in shower, reflecting contemporary design standards and efficient use of space.

Additional amenities include an elevator serving the building and a separate cellar for storage needs. Available to rent from September 1, 2026, the apartment provides a well-maintained residence within Bonnevoie, a multicultural and lively area known for its diverse dining options and vibrant market scene.
